reason: I forget pills at home all the time, so a counted sachet I can toss in my gym bag or suitcase actually fits how I live. $24.99 for the first box is low enough to just try it once.
objection: It's still two capsules every day, and I'll probably skip nights when I'm traveling or get home late, so I might not finish the box.
would_change_my_mind: If it was one capsule instead of two, I'd buy a second box without thinking. If the price was over $35 for one box I'd skip it.
